name: cloudtak-address-search-cli
description: Offline CLI: OpenAddresses export -> compact .pack file consumed by the CloudTAK address-search plugin. Never bundled by CloudTAK's Vite build, so unlike the browser plugin code this package may carry real runtime dependencies.
comment: No build step: Node 23.6+ runs TypeScript directly (type-stripping), so `node src/index.ts ...` and vitest both work unmodified. `typecheck` is the only place tsc is invoked, for real type errors.
